title: Triage answers a routine confirmation in a thread the assistant started, and reports the reply

messages.subject: Garden Room on 14 March
messages.body:
Hello Rowan,

As agreed on the phone, Sam Lee would like to book the Garden Room for the workshop on 14 March, from 10:00 to 16:00, for 18 people.

Best regards,
Assistant, assistant to Sam Lee

messages.subject: Re: Garden Room on 14 March
messages.body:
Hi,

Received, thanks! The Garden Room is yours on 14 March. Just to be sure: that is 10:00 to 16:00 for 18 people, right?

Best,
Rowan Hart
Harbour Hall

rubric: Is the reply short and polite, does it confirm only what the thread already says (14 March, 10:00 to 16:00, 18 people), and is it signed as the assistant to Sam Lee?
